decision.observation: Hornet stands on the mossy ledge in the lit hollow, beside the shell-stone rubble bank and the dark pillars. The ceiling is draped with hanging moss, and a carved shell relief marks the back wall. Below-left of the mossy ledge, round stone-tiled platforms descend into the dark foreground (~0.40, 0.54).
decision.hypothesis: The round stone-tiled platforms below-left of the mossy ledge may form a lower path that descends out of this hollow, which would be unexplored territory.
decision.memory: Lit pocket/pillar hollow: lower-left round stone platforms untested as a descending route.
